## Resolution

This has been completed! ✅

An official Home Assistant integration called **`rympro`** (Read Your Meter Pro) has been successfully merged into the official Home Assistant codebase.

**Details:**
- **Location:** https://github.com/home-assistant/core/tree/dev/homeassistant/components/rympro
- **Documentation:** https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/rympro/
- **Code Owners:** @OnFreund @elad-bar @maorcc

**Available Sensors:**
- Total consumption
- Monthly consumption
- Daily consumption
- Monthly forecast

The integration is now available as a built-in integration in Home Assistant and uses the JSON API approach (no scraping).
